question: **Directions: Choose the correctly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'Syringe.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us explore the options:-

 
 
• '**Sirynje**': There is no such word in English or we can say that there is some spelling mistake in this word.
 
• '**Syringe**': The correctly spelt word is 'Syringe' and it is **a plastic or glass tube with a needle that is used for taking a small amount of blood out of the body or for putting drugs into the body**. (प्‍लास्टिक या काँच से बनी सूई से युक्त एक नली; इंजेक्‍शन लगाने के लिए प्रयुक्त)
 
• '**Siringe**': There is no such word in English or we can say that there is some spelling mistake in this word.
 
• '**Cyrinje**': There is no such word in English or we can say that there is some spelling mistake in this word.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
